title: Mirror Defense Footwork
description: Partners face off and mirror lateral slides, retreats and closeouts without a ball, purely to build quick, balanced defensive footwork.

content.objective: Move the feet quickly and stay balanced while mirroring a partner's movement.
content.setup: Partners face each other two metres apart in a defensive stance, no ball involved.
instructions: The leader slides left and right unpredictably; the partner mirrors as the defender would.
Add forward and backward movement once side-to-side is comfortable.
Finish with a closeout rep: leader retreats, then partner closes out under control.
coachingPoints: Stay low with the chest up through every slide.
React to the hips, not the shoulders or the ball.
Keep the feet moving — don't let them settle flat.
commonMistakes: Standing up tall to move faster, which actually slows reactions.
Crossing the feet while sliding instead of a true slide step.
Rushing the stop before the feet are actually set.
content.safety: Keep a safe two-metre gap so partners don't collide on quick direction changes.
